stat_block.name: Test Dragon

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: Turn a failed save into a success.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) piercing damage.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each chosen creature within 120 feet must make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened.

action.name: Fire Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature in a cone makes a saving throw.

action.name: Breath Weapons {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

items.name: Cold Breath
items.entry: The dragon exhales an icy blast in a 60-foot cone. Each creature must make a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw, taking 58 ({@damage 13d8}) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: Paralyzing Breath
items.entry: The dragon exhales paralyzing gas in a 60-foot cone. Each creature must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute.

items.name: Force Pulse
entries: Creatures in a 30-foot line make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 4d8} force damage.

items.name: Slowing Pulse
entries: Creatures in a 30-foot line make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition restrained}.

legendary.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Beat its wings; creatures make a saving throw.

lairActions: On initiative count 20 the dragon uses one option:
